C0149.title: MPS Reveals Typical Case in 'Account Shutdown' Operation: Insider Collusion with Account Traffickers in Telecom Fraud
C0149.summary: In February 2022, the Ministry of Public Security released typical cases of cracking down on the black-market chain of online accounts. In one case, five insiders at a Guangdong telecom operator colluded with external individuals to provide account traffickers with 1.88 million unissued mobile phone numbers and SMS gateways for malicious registration and resale of online accounts.
